about: The opening's cameras. A point is {utm: [E, N], y: level} (German excavation zero) or {street: s, across: t, y: level | 'eye'}: s metres out on the lion street's line from the gate's face (gate-geom's street direction), t across it (+ west), the eye 1.65 m over the gate's street profile. The first frame is the flight's second 0 (the entry `first`, one camera per framing); the flight comes through the North Gate on the map's street axis (the lion frame) and ends still on the street 28 m inside its south door (`land`: the gate sketch's first key, street 150), looking level down the street at the double gate. Between the two the gate sketch's street line runs about 2.7 degrees west of the lion frame's (6 m at the North Gate), so the last 30 m drift that far west.
hourSays: the walk's one clock (map/sun.ts: 20 days after the spring equinox, 32.54 N, local apparent solar time): the landing at 16:40, five minutes before the gate's stop 2 (16:45); the sun at azimuth 265.8, 21.0 degrees high, on the right of a look down the street at heading 168

first.says: reading B2, the working start: from over the outer city north-west of the moat at +330, south-east over the North entry, the palaces and the river to the tower and the whole inner city; at 16:40 the sun from the right (west), about 101 degrees off the view. Readings A and B1 stay in `readings`; a swap of the start also moves the flight's first three points
